steps.title: where the chord turns
steps.body:
Before you can play over a progression you have to *feel* where it turns. A chord change is the moment the harmony moves under you.

- Listen to the bass and the chords, not the drums.
- Tap the pad on the beat the new chord arrives, not when you notice it.
- It starts slow, 8 beats per chord, and speeds up to 4 and then 2 as you land the changes.

This loop is C major, four chords: `I V vi IV`.
